title: Preservation Advance Carry on Retention Payoffs
content:
## Preservation advance carry — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction property preservation schedule

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the preservation advance carry enters the retention accrual basis.

**Clause.** The preservation advance carry is figured from the latest inspection result recorded on the loan's occupancy profile under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, read with the vacant-property securing setting of the maturity case's plan under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product, and only where that plan permits vacant-property securing: when the result found the home vacant and the loan's property type is FHA-approved condominium or planned unit development, it is USD 285.00, the vacant-property securing fee, plus the flat USD 120.00 association maintenance charge; when it found the home vacant and the property is of any other type, or is a Summit loan, which records no property type, it is USD 285.00 plus USD 55.00 of monthly maintenance for each of the months of vacancy; when the result was unable to determine, it is the flat USD 85.00 unconfirmed-occupancy securing fee; any other result, no result, or a plan that does not permit vacant-property securing carries nothing (0.00).

**Months of vacancy.** The months of vacancy are the whole calendar months from the occupancy profile's non-occupancy date to the statement date, not below 0, plus one; a profile with no non-occupancy date counts one month. A whole calendar month is complete when the same day of a later month is reached.

**Results on the same day.** Where several inspection results on the occupancy profile share the latest effective date, a vacant finding among them counts as the latest result, and otherwise an unable-to-determine finding does.

### Schedule applied to hypothetical cases

| Hypothetical case (securing permitted) | Preservation advance carry |
|---|---|
| Vacant; FHA-approved condominium | USD 405.00 (285.00 and 120.00) |
| Vacant; single-family HECM; non-occupancy date 15 January, statement date 20 April (3 whole months, plus one) | USD 505.00 (285.00 and 4 months of 55.00) |
| Vacant; Summit loan; no non-occupancy date (one month) | USD 340.00 |
| Unable to determine | USD 85.00 |
| Occupied | nothing |

Where the maturity case's plan does not permit vacant-property securing, every row above carries nothing. The dates and property types are invented for the illustration.
